bagPolicy.summary: A small purse is allowed. Backpacks, luggage and bags larger than a small purse are searched and must go into the paid coat check on the first floor.
allowed: Backpacks and larger bags, but only into the paid coat check
prohibited: Backpacks or bags larger than a small purse inside the venue
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are allowed but subject to search.

parking.note: Parking information is available by clicking the provided link. The Anthem is accessible by various transportation methods including Metro, bike, and car. There is bike parking and a Capital Bikeshare station nearby.

rideshare.note: For Uber, Lyft, or taxis, check your app for the designated pickup and drop-off point. Metro Access passengers use 900 Maine Avenue SW.

concessions.note: The Anthem offers a variety of handhelds such as Argentine beef empanadas, chicken masala wraps, and vegan falafel wraps. Shareables include sidewinder fries and cheesy potato pupusas. Beverage options feature a selection of bottled and draft beers, cocktails, and non-alcoholic drinks. A sustainability fee is applied to each transaction.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: For guidance on which seats may be most accessible (aisle seats, close to restrooms, etc.), please contact us before purchase. phone: 202-888-0020, or email ada@theanthemdc.com Accessible Entrances: Step-free access is available at our 900 Maine Ave entrance and our ADA entrance which is located between the venue’s main entrance and Whitlows Bar and Grill on Wharf St.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On show days, the box office will remain open one hour after the show begins.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Anthem's entrance and Box Office are behind the 900 block of Maine Avenue SW, on the waterfront, at 901 Wharf Street SW.
